# `<e-popover>`

<!-- No screenshot found. Run the screenshots test to generate one. -->

Click-triggered overlay panel anchored to its trigger.

The counterpart to a tooltip for hardware that has no hover: capacitive
e-paper digitizers report contact, not proximity, so anything that would be
revealed on hover has to be revealed on tap instead. Content is arbitrary,
which is what separates this from `<e-dropdown>` (a list of commands).

The panel is non-modal and does not trap focus. Reach for `<e-dialog>` when
the user must deal with the content before continuing.

> Source: [popover.ts](./popover.ts)

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `align` | `'left'\|'right'` | `'left'` | Horizontal alignment relative to the trigger. |
| `placement` | `'bottom'\|'top'` | `'bottom'` | Side of the trigger the panel opens on. |
| `heading` | `string` | — | Title rendered above the content and used as the panel's accessible name. |
| `open` | `boolean` | — | Reflects and controls visibility. |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `undefined` | `CustomEvent` |  |
| `e-open` | `CustomEvent<{value: boolean}>` | Fired after the panel opened. `value` is always `true`. |
| `e-close` | `CustomEvent<{value: boolean}>` | Fired after the panel closed. `value` is always `false`. |

## Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `trigger` | Element that opens the panel (typically an `<e-button>`). |
| _(default)_ | Panel content. |
